_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependencies are checked automatically for updates and known vulnerabilities, configured in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/renovate.json
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/issues
license_location_justification: The licence is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/LICENSE
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/commits/main
report_archive_justification: All reports and responses stay publicly searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/issues
sites_https_justification: The repository and its download URLs are served over HTTPS by GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming and the project website https://docs.typo3.org/p/netresearch/nr-xliff-streaming/main/en-us/
static_analysis_justification: PHPStan runs in CI on every change: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_justification: The repository carries 5 PHPUnit test files under Tests/, run by CI as shown in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Every pull request runs the test suite in GitHub Actions: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled and described in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/SECURITY.md: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/SECURITY.md
